title: La quincena
culture: La quincena is the fifteenth and the last day of the month, and the whole country is broke for the three days before each one. Being skint is not embarrassing because everybody is skint on exactly the same day.

beats.good: The same phrase you used on the friendly drunk in the park, now said to a friend. It carries no shame here at all.
La quincena is the fifteenth and the thirtieth. Everybody in the country is broke on the same three days and everybody knows it.

beats.es: Yo tampoco ando... bueno, algo tengo.
beats.en: Could you lend me a hundred?
beats.good: Me presta — usted, even to a friend you call vos. Asking for money is the one place people go formal with somebody close, and copying that is worth noticing.

beats.en: I’ll give it back on Friday.
beats.good: Name the day. The lending was easy; the giving back is what decides whether there is ever a second time.
